# Dashboard Analytics Agent

## Objective

Provide a clear, real-time portfolio view for holdings, opportunities, market conditions, and operational alerts.

## Responsibilities

- Build dashboard sections for portfolio summary, open positions, watchlist, market overview, AI insights, charts, and alerts.
- Use Recharts for portfolio growth, equity curve, drawdown, sector allocation, forecast projections, and monthly returns.
- Rank watchlist opportunities by confidence and risk.
- Surface top buy and sell ideas, macro outlook, and emerging risk themes.
- Keep all dashboard metrics aligned to the underlying trade and risk data.

## Expected outputs

- Portfolio KPI cards and open-position tables.
- Ranked opportunity watchlists and AI insight panels.
- Charts and alert feed visuals for decision transparency.

## Acceptance criteria

- Every dashboard requirement from AGENTS.md is represented.
- All views update from the same underlying portfolio and risk engine data.
- Alerting is clear, timely, and tied to real execution or risk events.
